table inet vedette_hp {
	set open {
		type ipv4_addr
	}

	set allow {
		type ipv4_addr . inet_proto . inet_service
		elements = { 192.168.18.242 . tcp . 22,
			     192.168.18.240 . tcp . 3389,
			     192.168.18.241 . tcp . 80,
			     192.168.18.240 . tcp . 445,
			     192.168.18.241 . tcp . 445 }
	}

	set touched {
		type ipv4_addr . ipv4_addr
		size 1024	# count 6
		flags dynamic,timeout
		timeout 2m
		elements = { 192.168.18.250 . 192.168.18.240 expires 41s863ms,
			     192.168.18.251 . 192.168.18.240 expires 1m39s899ms,
			     192.168.18.250 . 192.168.18.241 expires 41s924ms,
			     192.168.18.251 . 192.168.18.241 expires 1m39s899ms,
			     192.168.18.250 . 192.168.18.242 expires 41s980ms,
			     192.168.18.251 . 192.168.18.242 expires 1m39s899ms }
	}

	chain input {
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy accept;
		iif "lo" accept
		meta l4proto { tcp, udp } ct state new add @touched { ip saddr . ip daddr }
		ct state established,related accept
		ip daddr @open accept
		ip daddr . meta l4proto . th dport @allow accept
		meta l4proto tcp reject with tcp reset
		meta l4proto udp reject
	}

	chain output {
		type filter hook output priority filter; policy accept;
		ct state established,related accept
		oif "lo" accept
		ct state new drop
	}

	chain forward {
		type filter hook forward priority filter; policy drop;
	}
}
